notes: Current-source V2 only; no historical baseline comparison.
Each min/median/max summarizes nine per-invocation aggregates across three independent processes.
Medians of invocation p95s are not pooled-operation p95s.
Warmups excluded; Diagnostic timings not substituted for Sampled results.
CPU/allocation are process-wide and include instrumentation; per-success normalization is not attribution.
Busy worker count is a proxy; contained stack evidence is sparse, not full coverage.
